Description: 6-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each transaction. Starts with C for cancellations.
Business Relevance: Uniquely identifies orders and tracks cancellations/returns.

Description: 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each distinct product.
Business Relevance: Essential for inventory management and tracking product sales performance.
Used for product analytics and popular item classification.

Description: The quantities of each product per transaction.
Business Relevance: Measures sales volume demand patterns and basket size.

Description: The day and time when each transaction was generated.
Business Relevance: Crucial for peak sales analysis seasonality and time-based sales trends.

Description: Product price per unit in sterling (£).
Business Relevance: Used for revenue calculations and evaluating pricing strategy impact.

Description: 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each customer.
Business Relevance: Key for customer segmentation lifetime value (CLV) and RFM analysis.

Description: Name of the country where each customer resides.
Business Relevance: Helps in geographical market analysis and targeted regional marketing.

Description: Calculated field: Quantity * UnitPrice representing total spending per line item.
Business Relevance: Directly reflects gross revenue generated per item purchase.

Description: Extracted year and month of the transaction (YYYY-MM).
Business Relevance: Facilitates monthly revenue trend tracking and cohort analysis.

Description: Day of the week when the transaction took place.
Business Relevance: Identifies peak purchasing days during the week.

Description: Hour of the day (0-23) when the transaction occurred.
Business Relevance: Determines peak shopping hours for optimizing system load and promotions.
